info.cls_ename: Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 模擬學是一門結合統計學、程式設計、系統分析與設計、專案管理、工程經濟等領域的統整性學科。其目的在於針對一生產或服務系統：(一)於系統的設計階段，模擬系統的實際運作，分析可能的問題，以改善設計；(二)於系統的運作階段，針對已發生的問題，模擬執行可能的改善方案，並分析成本效益。
description.describe_eh: Simulation is an interdisciplinary course that involves statistics, programming, system analysis and design, project management, industrial economics, etc. The purpose of this course is twofold: (1) To simulate the practical operation of a system at the design stage to find out possible problems on which design improvement is based; and (2) to simulate the execution of possible improvement alternatives for an existing problem and to evaluate the costs and benefits at the operation stage.

targets.describe_ch: 能了解隨機性與相互依賴性造成系統分析的困難。
targets.describe_en: Understand the difficulties of system analysis caused by randomness and interdependency.

targets.describe_ch: 能了解模擬的基本觀念，包括種類、步驟、可能的應用與國際觀等。
targets.describe_en: Understand the basic concepts of simulation including the types, steps, possible applications and so on of simulationwith an international perspective.

targets.describe_ch: 能團隊合作並擬定資料收集之計畫、執行計畫、然後分析所收集的資料。
targets.describe_en: Be able to teamwork and to establish a data collection plan, implement the plan, and analyze the data collected.

targets.describe_ch: 能應用模擬軟體PROMODEL，建構一生產或服務系統的模擬模型。
targets.describe_en: Be able to apply simulation software PROMODEL to construct the simulation model of a production or service system.
